youtube.title: The Day the Ground Opened Under a Boy #Shorts
youtube.description:
Years pass in Centralia and the ground gets warm. In winter, snow melts in strange patches. Basements fill with deadly gas, and people start getting sick. Then in 1981 a twelve-year-old boy is walking in a backyard when the ground opens under his feet. He falls into a steaming hole, deep enough to kill him, and hangs on to a tree root until his cousin pulls him out. A few people still live there today. Full episode on the channel.

#Shorts #Centralia #History #Explained #thehiddenwhy

instagram.caption: Snow melting in strange patches. Basements filling with gas. Then in 1981, the ground opened under a twelve-year-old boy and he hung on to a tree root over a steaming hole. This is what living above a coal fire looked like. #thehiddenwhy #Centralia #History #Explained
